title: Finite-type quasi-coherent submodules extend across a qc open
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] which is quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let $U\subseteq X$ be a quasi-compact open subscheme, let $\mathcal F$ be a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and let $\mathcal G\subseteq\mathcal F|_U$ be a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_U$-submodule of finite type (locally a quotient of $\mathcal O_U^{\oplus n}$ with $n$ finite). Then there is a quasi-coherent finite-type submodule $\mathcal G'\subseteq\mathcal F$ whose restriction to $U$ equals $\mathcal G$ as a submodule of $\mathcal F|_U$.

mathlib_searches.query: extend finite type quasi-coherent submodule from quasi-compact open of qcqs scheme
mathlib_searches.results: No extension theorem for finite-type quasi-coherent submodules
